title: Abhyankar lemma for tame extensions of discrete valuation rings
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: The proof first kills a unit factor through a finite etale extension and descends the desired formal smoothness. It then reduces to adjoining a root of a uniformizer, computes ramification indices and residue separability after normalization, and proves that the new local extensions are unramified.
